title: Factory Stage 7 evidence artifact (v1)
description: Canonical form of one Stage 7 evidence artifact: one invariant, one observation, one attempt. Documented companion to scripts/lib/evidence-artifact.mjs, which is the executable authority CI runs. Design rationale: docs/opsiq/evidence/stage-7/EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_SPEC.md. Lane-conditional rules (producer type per lane, deployment_id per lane, replay per lane) are expressed in allOf below and enforced identically by the library.

evidence_version.description: Schema version of this artifact. Only 1.0.0 exists.

artifact_id.description: Derived, never chosen: 'evd_' + first 32 hex of sha256 over the canonical envelope with artifact_id and signature removed. The file must be named <artifact_id>.json.

invariant_id.description: The Stage 7 invariant this artifact is offered against.

lane.description: Evidence lane, per docs/opsiq/bundles/factory-stage-7-closure.yaml. S7-I10 declares LANE_C+LANE_E and is proven by one artifact in each lane, not by a combined lane value.

proof_type.description: The contract's declared proof_type for this invariant, copied verbatim.

artifact_classification.description: Who this artifact may be shown to. Raw production observations default to INTERNAL_ONLY.

captured_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 instant with an explicit Z suffix. Must fall inside the producing run's window.

subject_sha.description: Full 40-hex commit the observation was made against. Under --require-provenance it must be an ancestor of origin/main.

deployment_id.description: Deployment identifier. Required for LANE_C, forbidden for LANE_E and OWNER_ACCEPTANCE.

producer.description: Who produced this artifact. An interactive agent session has no representable value here — that is deliberate.

repository.description: owner/name of the repository that produced the artifact.

run_id.description: GitHub Actions run id, as a decimal string. Required on CI lanes, forbidden on owner lanes.

owner_identity.description: Owner GitHub login. Required on owner lanes, forbidden on CI lanes.

owner_attestation_ref.description: URL of a GitHub issue or PR comment authored by the owner, containing this artifact_id and subject_sha. Required on owner lanes.

replay.description: How to reproduce the observation. Owner judgment is inherently non-replayable; that is a property, not a deficiency.

observation.description: The verbatim observation and its hash. Never paraphrased, never re-serialised before hashing.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of observation.raw exactly.

truncated.description: True when the capture helper truncated the observation at its size cap. A truncated observation still hashes what it stored.

assertion.description: The specific claim this observation supports. Not a restatement of the invariant.

supersedes.description: artifact_id this artifact replaces. Artifacts are append-only: a correction is a new artifact, never an in-place edit.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical envelope with signature removed, keyed by the CI-only EVIDENCE_SIGNING_KEY. null when the key was not provisioned — such an artifact can never exceed acceptance level UNVERIFIED.

allOf.title: CI lanes are produced by GitHub Actions and are replayable
Owner lanes are produced by the owner and are not replayable
LANE_C observations name the deployment they were taken from
LANE_E runs in an isolated environment and names no deployment
